title: Dishes
description: What guests pre-order. Counts are submitted pre-order items of confirmed bookings; the time axis is the booking's start in Asia/Tbilisi.

list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at
list.definition: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Top dishes overall and per location
panels.description: The ten most ordered dishes. A bar's length is the total, its segments are the locations.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT i.dish_id, t.location_id, sum(i.quantity)::int AS quantity
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
  GROUP BY i.dish_id, t.location_id
), top AS (
  SELECT o.dish_id, d.name, sum(o.quantity) AS total
  FROM ordered o
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = o.dish_id
  GROUP BY o.dish_id, d.name
  ORDER BY total DESC, d.name
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT top.name AS dish, l.address AS location, COALESCE(o.quantity, 0) AS quantity
FROM top
CROSS JOIN locations l
LEFT JOIN ordered o ON o.dish_id = top.dish_id AND o.location_id = l.id
WHERE l.id IN ($location)
ORDER BY top.total DESC, top.name, l.created_at

panels.title: Category mix by lunch and dinner
panels.description: Share of each category among the items ordered for lunch (starts 12:00 to 14:30) and for dinner (starts 18:00 to 21:30). Other start times are left out.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN (b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::time BETWEEN '12:00' AND '14:30' THEN 'lunch'
           WHEN (b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::time BETWEEN '18:00' AND '21:30' THEN 'dinner'
         END AS meal,
         d.category, i.quantity
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
), meals AS (
  SELECT sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE meal = 'lunch') AS lunch,
         sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE meal = 'dinner') AS dinner
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT CASE o.category
         WHEN 'APPETIZER' THEN 'Appetizers'
         WHEN 'MAIN_COURSE' THEN 'Main courses'
         WHEN 'DESSERT' THEN 'Desserts'
       END AS "Category",
       100.0 * COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.meal = 'lunch'), 0) / meals.lunch AS "Lunch",
       100.0 * COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.meal = 'dinner'), 0) / meals.dinner AS "Dinner"
FROM ordered o
CROSS JOIN meals
WHERE o.meal IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.category, meals.lunch, meals.dinner
ORDER BY o.category

panels.title: Dish popularity by hour of day
panels.description: Items ordered of the ten most ordered dishes, by the hour the booking starts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT d.name, extract(hour FROM b.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi')::int AS hour, i.quantity
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
), top AS (
  SELECT name, sum(quantity) AS total
  FROM ordered
  GROUP BY name
  ORDER BY total DESC, name
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT o.name AS "Dish",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 10), 0)::int AS "10:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 11), 0)::int AS "11:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 12), 0)::int AS "12:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 13), 0)::int AS "13:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 14), 0)::int AS "14:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 15), 0)::int AS "15:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 16), 0)::int AS "16:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 17), 0)::int AS "17:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 18), 0)::int AS "18:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 19), 0)::int AS "19:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 20), 0)::int AS "20:00",
       COALESCE(sum(o.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.hour = 21), 0)::int AS "21:00"
FROM ordered o
JOIN top ON top.name = o.name
GROUP BY o.name, top.total
ORDER BY top.total DESC, o.name
